verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents that every sandbox is exposed via an official MCP server enabling agents to operate it via tool calls, and it offers a serverless 'MCP Server Hosting' service for hosting remote MCP servers, with a dedicated docs page confirmed by probe. This is a platform (not itself an agent), so the connect-via-official-MCP-server axis clearly applies and is met by first-party evidence. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of connecting an external agent to these MCP servers, and more detail on the protocol/setup beyond the docs summary.
